summary_en: 700,000 ordinary shares (1.46% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) cancelled effective 2026-06-26. Post-cancellation issued shares: 49,527,200.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: TDC SOFT Inc. announced on 2026-06-26 the completion of cancellation of 700,000 ordinary treasury shares, decided by the board on 2026-05-13 under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancelled shares represent 1.46% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury) prior to cancellation. Post-cancellation, the company has 49,527,200 issued ordinary shares.
